/packages/12-days-egypt-tour-to-cairo/.name: 12-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Hurghada
faq: What does the 12-day Egypt tour include?

Eleven nights in 5-star places - 3 in Cairo, 3 on a deluxe Nile cruise and 5 at a Hurghada resort - plus domestic flights between Cairo, Aswan and Hurghada, private air-conditioned transport, a private Egyptologist guide, entrance fees on the itinerary, a quad bike safari and a snorkeling trip. International flights, the Egypt visa and tips are not included.
Is Abu Simbel part of this tour?
Yes. Day 4 is an early-morning excursion from Aswan to the temples of Ramses II and Queen Nefertari at Abu Simbel, before the cruise sails north to Kom Ombo and Edfu.
How do we travel between Cairo, Aswan, Luxor and Hurghada?

You fly from Cairo to Aswan, sail the Nile from Aswan to Luxor, drive by private vehicle from Luxor to Hurghada, and fly from Hurghada back to Cairo. Airport meet-and-assist and every transfer are included.
How much free time is there in Hurghada?
Five nights at a 5-star Red Sea resort. The quad bike safari and the snorkeling excursion are included; the other days are free for the beach, or for diving and water sports at extra cost.
Which Cairo sights are included?

The Giza Pyramids, the Great Sphinx, Saqqara's Step Pyramid and the Grand Egyptian Museum on day 2, a Nile dinner cruise with a Tanoura show on arrival, and on day 11 the Egyptian Museum, the Citadel, Islamic Cairo and Khan El Khalili.

Three nights on a 5-star Nile cruise with full board, an Egyptologist guide, entrance fees to the sites visited, transfers in air-conditioned vehicles, and all service charges and taxes. Prices start from $360 per person; international flights, the Egypt visa and tips are extra.
Which temples and sites do we visit?
Philae Temple and Aswan's sights on day 1, Kom Ombo and Edfu on day 2, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple and the Colossi of Memnon on day 3, and Karnak and Luxor temples on day 4.
Is there a holiday celebration on board?
Yes. Festive Christmas or New Year celebrations and evening entertainment on board are part of the trip, alongside the daily guided sightseeing.
Where does the cruise start and finish?
You board in Aswan on day 1 and finish in Luxor on day 4, with a departure transfer after the visits to Karnak and Luxor Temple.

/tours/saqqara-memphis-dahshur-day-trip-.name: Saqqara, Memphis & Dahshur Day Trip from Cairo
faq: How long does the tour take?
Six to eight hours, with pick-up and drop-off at your hotel in Cairo or Giza by private air-conditioned vehicle.
What will we see?
The Step Pyramid of King Djoser at Saqqara, the colossal statue of Ramses II and the Alabaster Sphinx at Memphis, and the Bent and Red Pyramids at Dahshur.
Why visit Saqqara and Dahshur if I have already seen Giza?
They show how pyramid building began and developed before Giza - from Djoser's Step Pyramid to the Bent and Red Pyramids at Dahshur.
Are entrance tickets included?
No. Entrance tickets to the archaeological sites are paid separately; the price covers private transport, pick-up and drop-off, bottled water and assistance before and during the trip.
Is lunch included?
Lunch is optional: if you choose it when booking, the tour stops at a local restaurant on the way back. Otherwise meals are not included.
